data.one_liner: Android plugin to read current cellular and Wi‑Fi signal strengths.
data.what_it_does: Provides async methods to check if the device is on cellular or Wi‑Fi and to retrieve the current signal strengths. It exposes a simple API with no external dependencies beyond Flutter.
use_when: You need to monitor network signal strength for debugging or UI feedback
You want to display signal bars or log connectivity quality in an Android app
avoid_when: You target iOS or cross‑platform apps
You need a comprehensive network monitoring solution with more metrics
strengths: Straightforward API, no code generation required
Supports both cellular and Wi‑Fi signal queries
weaknesses: Requires SDK 23+, and devices below SDK 28 cannot report cellular strength
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and import the package. No native configuration or permissions are required.
